_about: Policy for the Agent HQ dispatcher (dispatcher.js). It drafts a reply for every session waiting on Mohammed and logs what it would send. mode 'shadow' sends nothing; no other mode is implemented yet. Edit freely; the dashboard reloads this file on every draft.

rules.text: stop asking me for silly permissions. If it can be done safely by you and no risky or non reversible decisions, then do it.
You will make all of the decisions except sensitive financial ones and legal ones. I'm not going to intervene. I'm not going to follow up.
rules.source: Mohammed, 2026-11-13, about job and program applications, quoted in mybrain infra/AUTONOMY.md

rules.text: A session that ends a turn asking for a go-ahead on a safe, reversible step has failed the task. Try every allowed route first, then report.

alwaysHuman: legal signatures, attestations or consent he has not already answered
typing his passwords, verification codes, emailed verify links, CAPTCHAs or other bot checks
anything irreversible that his standing rules do not already authorize (deleting without a backup, force-pushing, publishing a release)
questions only he can answer: facts about his life, his preferences, plans, opinions or private information
anything he told that session to hold or wait on
